acceptanceCriteria: Default output reports the excluded count and digest; the full list is behind an explicit option.
Repeated universe and invalidation values are stated once.
Selected units report test counts by default.
The affected-plan profile change and its consumers are handled per the spec; measured bytes recorded.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the owner-requested token-usage audit (owner: ensure Corvint and corvint-tasks are optimal with token usage at all times). Measured on rc3-cleanup head 79536edd and 72 h of this project's Claude Code transcripts; tokens about bytes/4.

Measured: 101 KB raw on a clean tree, 151 KB for a 27-file range; plan.excluded has 290-365 items of 338 B each repeating an 87-char universe digest and a fixed invalidation (internal/liveverify/affected/select.go:151-152, cmd/corvint/affected.go:502); selected[].tests lists every test file (102 for one package). About 60 calls a day; agents filter it today, but unfiltered it is about 7 MB a day.

All hosted CI checks passed. ci-control-plane was admin-posted on head 1ec61878 with the owner's explicit authorization for the .github/cishards changes. The batch CEM was bound and sealed (dogfood check PASS), and Codex reviewed the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0943-affected-compact-plan.md, docs/decisions/0449-v1-0943-affected-plan-1-compact-default-2026-10-07.md, docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-c-compact-plan-consumers.md at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256); the build log records the focused tests and limits.
